prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production raster sprite for Trætoppen, a cozy painted storybook 2D farming game. Style: matte hand-painted gouache/watercolor, visible subtle paper pigment and timber grain, gentle irregular warm pencil contours, charming readable functional silhouette. Palette: honey timber, bark brown, sage moss green, warm cream, muted terracotta, small dull brass accents. Orthographic isometric camera elevated 36 degrees, two equally visible sides, no perspective convergence. Soft upper-left daylight, modest contact shading only, no cast shadow beyond the object. Isolate the complete subject with generous transparent padding on a genuinely transparent background. No typography, labels, borders, scenery, UI, black outlines, glossy 3D render, plastic, vector geometry, pixel art, neon or watermark. Primary request: ONE small walk-in fairy farm greenhouse. A rectangular four-by-three tile footprint, honey timber and sage painted slender frame, warm frosted clear glass walls and gabled glass roof, cream stone low foundation, terracotta ridge caps, small brass door handle. Friendly hinged door on the front facing down-left, fully visible and closed. No plants or soil extending outside its footprint. Architecture should harmonize with a rustic plaster-and-timber chicken coop with terracotta tiles. Entire building including its ground contact visible; no platform under it. Square canvas.
